Safeguarding

The safety and wellbeing of young people is our top priority. All our adult volunteers are DBS checked and complete regular safeguarding training. We follow The Scout Association's safeguarding policies and procedures.

If you have any safeguarding concerns, please contact our Group Lead Volunteer at glv@7thswindon.org.uk or visit The Scout Association's safeguarding information.
